findings.line: RouteSegmentReceiptV1 completed invariant; Apply eligibility after ProposalEnvelopeV1
findings.scenario: A completed RouteSegmentReceiptV1 carries proposalEnvelopeHash but omits interruptHash/decisionHash. The completed rule only adds interrupt/decision/accept-proposal requirements for 'proposal-HITL completion', so a validator can treat this mix as schema-valid. Apply eligibility then succeeds from that receipt plus any ReceiptBundleManifestV1 that lists it and a frozen foundation receipt, without a unique accept-proposal slot decision.
findings.remediation: Make completed+proposalEnvelopeHash require the unique interruptHash, decisionHash, and decisionValue accept-proposal; any other completed/proposal mix fails validation. Apply eligibility must require those same hashes on that completed receipt and fail closed if they are absent or not accept-proposal.

findings.scenario: A slash command produces SlashCommandInvocationV1, but slashInvocationHash is optional on the intent, so the segment can drop the command binding. After active→interrupted the command/registry expires, is revoked, or is killed while the skill admission stays live. accept-proposal treats the command as not present and CASes interrupted→completed.
findings.remediation: If a slash command selected the skill, slashInvocationHash is mandatory on the intent for the whole segment. Omission of a used command binding is invalid. accept-proposal fails closed unless that command entry and registry remain unexpired, unrevoked, unkilled, and owner-bound.

audit.proof_assessment: v3 FINDINGS target these same bytes but describe a pre-remediation draft. The supplied text already closes unique genesis InterruptDecisionSlotV1 keyed by interruptHash with one undecided→decided CAS, interrupted→completed|cancelled with no return to active, and live skill/context/interrupt/decision/owner/kill-switch gates on accept-proposal. Treat those three v3 MEDIUMs as stale. Remaining criterion gaps are closed combinations at the apply/receipt boundary and optional command binding that can drop command liveness at completion.
residual_risks: ReceiptBundleManifestV1 has no control-plane authorship, per-jobId uniqueness, owners, or kill switch; any reconstructible hash list can satisfy the apply packaging gate.
HumanInterruptV1.issuer is a spoofable literal; control-plane authorship is prose-only.
ContextFragmentV1.normalizedBytes is unspecified as count vs payload and could embed content in hash-chained records.
Kill switch on an interrupted segment blocks accept but is not listed as a cancellation trigger, so the reservation can remain held until interrupt expiry.
effectiveToolGrantHash 'recorded subset' is not subset-provable unless both grant bodies are resolved and intersected.
Mandatory human-decision fragments can deadlock first-turn packing if 'applicable route' is ignored.
Unicode line separators/bidi/homoglyphs can spoof composer display while ASCII slash grammar stays closed.
No accessibility contract for pre-dispatch included/excluded source disclosure.
SkillInvocationReceiptV1 terminal states are not a closed enum with the same non-completed proposal ban.
